name: context_mode
notes: Generated on 2026-04-03 from manual MCP context-mode runs against tests/fixtures/sample-app.
Startup cost is based on the first repo-inspection response needed to locate relevant files, counted from returned rg-style evidence rather than hidden server-side indexing.
Retrieval and end-to-end costs count full returned sections from ctx_batch_execute search results until the correct answer first appears.
Session scenarios were benchmarked by indexing the provided setup events as a searchable session.log section because context-mode does not provide native causal session memory.
